script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

INT. ACKERMAN HIGH SCHOOL GYM - DAY

JAMES, a tall, athletic teenager with a determined expression, watches as his coach, COACH MCCORMICK, addresses the team.

COACH MCCORMICK
(looking around the room)
We have a long season ahead of us. But I believe we have what it takes to make it to the state championships. Who's with me?

ALL
(in unison)
We're with you, Coach!

James exchanges glances with his teammate, MELISSA. They both harbor secret ambitions.

INT. ACKERMAN HIGH SCHOOL - LATER

James and Melissa sit in the school library, surrounded by books. They discuss their dreams of attending a top-tier college and playing on a division one team.

JAMES
(leaning forward)
We need to put in extra work if we want to stand out.

MELISSA
(nodding)
Absolutely. But how do we get noticed?

James pauses, then a determined look crosses his face.

JAMES
I have an idea. Let's start our own training program. Just the two of us, pushing each other to be the best.

INT. ACKERMAN HIGH SCHOOL GYM - NIGHT

James and Melissa train late into the night. They challenge each other, pushing beyond their limits.

INT. ACKERMAN HIGH SCHOOL CAFETERIA - DAY

The team gathers for lunch. James and Melissa's hard work starts to pay off, as they outshine their teammates during practice.

TEAMMATE 1
(whispering to Teammate 2)
What's going on with James and Melissa? They're suddenly unstoppable!

TEAMMATE 2
(shrugs)
I don't know. But we better watch out.

INT. ACKERMAN HIGH SCHOOL - LATER

Coach McCormick calls James and Melissa into his office. He's impressed by their dedication and offers them a chance to train with the varsity team.

INT. ACKERMAN HIGH SCHOOL GYM - DAY

James and Melissa train alongside the varsity team, determined to prove themselves worthy. They push through the challenges, never giving up.

INT. REGIONAL CHAMPIONSHIP GAME - DAY

The team faces off against their toughest opponents yet. James and Melissa lead the charge, demonstrating their newfound skills and determination.

INT. REGIONAL CHAMPIONSHIP GYM - NIGHT

The team celebrates their victory. James and Melissa look at each other, proud of their accomplishments.

MELISSA
(smiling)
We did it.

James nods, a determined look in his eyes.

JAMES
But this is just the beginning. We'll keep pushing, and one day, we'll make it to the top.

FADE OUT.
